name: LineNumbering
description: Represents line numbers in the left margin or to the left of each newspaper-style column.
remarks: Use the LineNumbering property to return the LineNumbering object. The following example applies line numbering to the text in the first section of the active document. The following example applies line numbering to the pages in the current section.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified LineNumbering object.

properties.name: RestartMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the way line numbering runs - that is, whether it starts over at the beginning of a new page or section or runs continuously. Read/write WdNumberingRule.

properties.name: StartingNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the starting line number. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceFromText
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the right edge of line numbers and the left edge of the document text. Read/write Single.

properties.name: CountBy
properties.description: Returns or sets the numeric increment for line numbers. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: True if line numbering is active for the specified document, section, or sections. Read/write Long.
